source:
@@U02244@@
Ah, and the things / have to contend with!
Day after day we do all we can to save,
but day after day our needs increase,
along with my troubles.
The cooks, of course, lack for nothing.
Wild boar, venison, rabbit, turkey, chicken,
geese and ducks, payment in kind as
secured revenue,
these still come in fairly regularly.
But we are short on wine.
There was a time when cask on cask
was piled high in the cellar,
the best vineyards, the best vintages,
but the endless guzzling of the nobles
has drained us to the last drops.
The City Council, too, has had to
tap its stocks. They grab any mug or bowl
to swill ic down, and the next thing you know
they're under the table.
So now I pay bills and wages with money from loans
that eat up the future before it’s arrived.
Our pigs haven't time to fatten,
the pillow’s been pawned that we lay our heads on,
and even the bread on the table is mortgaged.

@@U02246@@
(To 梅菲斯特, after a moments reflection.)

@@U02247@@
And you, Fool,
what complaint do you have?

@@U02249@@
I? Why, none! None at all!
I only look around and see the splendor
of you and your court! Can confidence
be lacking where Your Majesty wields absolute power
and has forces to rout all opposition?
Where goodwill is strengthened by ready intelligence,
and energy of many kinds is at his disposal?
translation:
@@U02244@@
啊，还有必须应对的事情！
日复一日，我们竭尽全力拯救，
但我们的需求日复一日地增加，
连同我的烦恼。
厨师们当然什么也不缺。
野猪、鹿肉、兔子、火鸡、鸡肉、
鹅和鸭，以实物付款
有保障的收入，
这些仍然相当频繁地出现。
但我们缺酒。
曾经有一段时间，木桶叠木桶
地窖里堆得高高的，
最好的葡萄园，最好的年份，
但贵族们无休无止的饕餮
已经耗尽了我们的最后一滴。
市议会也必须
挖掘其股票。他们抓住任何杯子或碗
吞下ic，接下来你知道的
他们在桌子下面。
所以现在我用贷款来支付账单和工资
在未来到来之前就把它吃掉。
我们的猪还没有时间养肥，
我们头枕的枕头被典当了，
连桌上的面包都抵押了。

@@U02246@@
（沉思片刻后对梅菲斯特说。）

@@U02247@@
还有你，傻瓜，
你有什么抱怨？

@@U02249@@
我？为什么，没有！一点也没有！
我只环顾四周，看到辉煌
你和你的法庭！能否信心十足
缺少陛下掌握绝对权力的地方
并拥有击溃一切反对派的力量？
当善意因现成的情报而得到加强时，
他可以使用多种能量吗？
